ترتعفوا (form VIII)
# تَرْتَعِفُوا (tartaʕifū) /tar.ta.ʕi.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
# تُرْتَعَفُوا (turtaʕafū) /tur.ta.ʕa.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
